data.description: User-selected local, mounted, worktree, container-backed, or prepared remote checkout locations operated on directly by project Chats. File changes take effect immediately and are not automatically undone with Chat cancellation or deletion. Opt-in portable session history may live inside the workspace and travel through ordinary version control.
data.name: Project Workspaces and Git
data.technology: Filesystem directories, Git worktrees/repositories, mounted checkouts
